epic: Knesset Full-Law Source Qualification & LawID Resolution

official_source.name: מאגר החקיקה הלאומי (Knesset National Legislation Database)
official_source.api_format: XML (WCF datacontract) / public JSON-style; no auth, no token
official_source.document_files: PDFs on https://fs.knesset.gov.il/<knesset>/law/<n>_lsr_<id>.PDF (ספר החוקים — original enactment + each amendment)
official_source.consolidated_text_route: ספר החוקים הפתוח / OpenLawBook (openBookUrl field) — PARTIAL coverage; often empty
official_source.kolzchut_link: kolZchutUrl (secondary rights guide, not primary law)

content_returned_by_api.general: hebSubject, lawValidity (תקף/נושן/בטל), publicationDate, latestPublicationDate, openBookUrl, kolZchutUrl, knsName, validity dates
content_returned_by_api.corrections.listCorrections[]: per amendment: itemId, name, correctionType (ישיר/עקיף), correctionNumber, publicationDate, publicationSeries (ספר החוקים), magazineNumber, pageNumber, filePath (PDF), fileType, summaryLaw

document_type_finding.consolidated_current_text: PARTIAL — only via OpenLawBook (openBookUrl) for a subset of laws; not comprehensive/inline
document_type_finding.conclusion: The API + site provide law METADATA + the full amendment-PUBLICATION document set (PDFs). A comprehensive official free CONSOLIDATED current text (נוסח משולב) does NOT exist for all laws.

lawid_resolution.method: EXACT structural: GetLegislationLawItem ItemId == OData IsraelLawID (KNS_IsraelLaw.Id / KNS_IsraelLawName.IsraelLawID)
lawid_resolution.coverage: 2,180 IsraelLawIDs in KNS_IsraelLawName resolve 1:1 by the formula; per-law existence verifiable via GetLegislationLawItem returning matching hebSubject

terms_robots_reuse.robots_main.knesset.gov.il: Disallow / for named aggressive bots only (Yandex, Semrush, MJ12, dotbot, PetalBot, ...). No User-agent:* disallow → a polite identified collector is NOT blocked.
terms_robots_reuse.content_reuse_basis: statutory_exemption (§6 Copyright Act — no copyright in laws) → content OPEN
terms_robots_reuse.technical_access_permission: apparently_allowed (public gov API, no auth; robots permits *)
terms_robots_reuse.site_terms: gov/Knesset ToS to be recorded as evidence (license_evidence_url + hash)
terms_robots_reuse.document_license: official gazette PDFs are public government documents

versioning.capability: PUBLICATION_HISTORY (full) — every amendment dated (correctionNumber, publicationDate, itemId, ספר החוקים page); lawValidity gives repeal status
versioning.consolidated_point_in_time: CURRENT_ONLY where OpenLawBook exists; else publication-history-only
versioning.incremental_sync: poll GetLegislationLawItem per law; new correctionNumber / latestPublicationDate = update; checkpoint key = IsraelLawID + max(correctionNumber); dedup key = correction itemId + PDF content hash

access_recommendation: official_api (metadata + amendment index, keyed by IsraelLawID) + direct_pdf (fetch ספר-החוקים PDFs from fs.knesset.gov.il) + PDF text extraction + the existing section parser. OpenLawBook (openBookUrl) for consolidated text where available.

fixes: PDF fetch + text-extraction pipeline for fs.knesset.gov.il documents (with OCR fallback only where no text layer)
qualify OpenLawBook (openBookUrl) coverage — how many laws have consolidated נוסח משולב
record Knesset ToS as license_evidence (url + hash); implement attribution/source-link
policy for laws WITHOUT consolidated text: ingest amendment documents at document-level, clearly labelled 'not a consolidated current text' — never presented as נוסח נכון-לתאריך
decision.consolidated_current_text_for_rag_beta: PARTIAL / ASK — a comprehensive official free consolidated text does not exist; RAG Beta on consolidated text is possible only for the OpenLawBook subset. Do NOT build a corpus as if full נוסח משולב exists for all laws.

next_task: Qualify OpenLawBook (ספר החוקים הפתוח) consolidated-text coverage + endpoint, and build the fs.knesset.gov.il PDF fetch+extract collector feeding the existing section parser.
